summary: Cypherpunk Technologies Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing that it received a Nasdaq letter on September 2, 2026, confirming it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) minimum bid price requirement, closing the matter. The company had previously been notified of non-compliance on July 20, 2026, due to a bid price below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. No transactions, offers, or strategic actions were involved. This is a routine regulatory-compliance update, not a special situation. What to watch: continued compliance with Nasdaq listing standards for potential future delisting risk.
